description: You are the HR Manager at a professional services firm conducting the annual leave entitlement audit. Company policy mandates that every employee in the Sales department must have an approved Paid Time Off allocation of at least 20 days per year, and must also carry the 'Sales' employee tag for reporting purposes. Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Audit every employee in the Sales department: for each one who lacks an approved Paid Time Off allocation of at least 20 days, either create a new approved 20-day allocation or correct their existing one to 20 days. Additionally, ensure every Sales department employee has the 'Sales' tag assigned. You are not told which Sales employees exist or what their current allocation status is — you must investigate and correct all deficiencies yourself.
